subject: Offer packet: salary exception request & staggered start plan — Sarah Johnson
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer draft for Sarah Johnson — request for comp exception and start plan

Hi Ben / Neha,

Attached is the preliminary offer packet for Sarah Johnson (Senior Infra Engineer). Recruiter flagged that the candidate is asking for a base that sits above our published comp band for the level; candidate currently has strong counteroffers and is asking for $210k base. Our band for Sr Infra is $160k-$190k.

What I need from you:
- Ben: please review the attached offer_letter_v1.pdf and suggest redlines for any clauses (probation, bonus clawback, relocation timing).
- Neha: can you confirm manager-level willingness to support a band exception up to $210k and whether we can make a signing bonus or retention tranche part of the approval?

Other considerations:
- Candidate prefers a staggered start (remote-first for 2 months, then onsite) due to relocation logistics; may need a flexible start date (between Oct 5–Nov 2).
- Recruiter asked about a relocation reimbursement and whether we can pro-rate a signing bonus if start is delayed.

I'm looping in the hiring tracker link and a draft DocuSign flow in the attachments. If we want to approve a band exception, I suggest we document the justification (comp market + unique infra skills) and attach a short sign-off note.

Attachment: offer_letter_v1.pdf (PDF, 24KB)

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer draft for Sarah Johnson — request for comp exception and start plan

Laura — thanks for the draft. Quick inline thoughts and a couple of suggested redlines (see attached redlined_offer_v2.pdf):

1) Compensation: I support a limited exception but would prefer a structured approach: approve base at $205k (1000 less than ask) plus a $15k signing bonus split 50/50 at onboarding and at 6 months, contingent on remaining employed. That keeps TCO closer to hiring band while addressing candidate leverage.

2) Probation / Term: Add explicit 90-day performance review language to the offer and remove any ambiguous "at-will" phrasing that could confuse international hires. Also include a clause that the signing bonus is repayable if the employee voluntarily leaves within 12 months.

3) Start date: Approve a staggered start option (remote-first up to 8 weeks) but require relocation plan submission within 30 days of start to qualify for relocation reimbursement. Reimbursement payment timing: on receipt of receipts and after completion of relocation (paid in final payroll of first month onsite).

4) Immigration: If candidate needs sponsorship / visa support, we need recruiters to confirm timeline. For comp exception sign-off, state manager approves subject to People ops confirmation of visa timeline.

If we agree, I'll prepare a short justification memo for Finance and the hiring committee (approx. one paragraph) to attach to the approval. Also note: hiring tracker ENG-HEAD-54 still shows headcount reserved; need final OK from Finance for the comp increment.

Attachment: redlined_offer_v2.pdf (PDF, 33KB)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Engineering Recruiting Ops
ben_carter@redwood.com

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Offer for Sarah Johnson — clean copy for candidate and timeline questions

Forwarding the updated offer for Sarah (clean copy attached). Ben proposed an approval path: base $205k + $15k signing bonus split 50/50 with standard 12-month repayment clause, and explicit 90-day performance review language. Neha — please confirm manager-level sign-off so I can move this to Finance for the comp exception paperwork.

Recruiter — please confirm the following with Sarah before we send the DocuSign link:
- Can she start remotely between Oct 5–Nov 2 (flexible)?
- Is she requesting visa support or will she be working on existing authorization? If visa required, supply expected start constraint.
- Confirm relocation timeline and whether she wants reimbursement paid on proof-of-move (as proposed) or needs an advance.

Attachment: offer_letter_clean_v2.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

Thanks,
Laura
--

Subject: Re: Offer for Sarah Johnson — a few final questions

Hi Laura / Recruiting team — thank you for sending the updated offer. Happy to hear there's flexibility on compensation and a path to the signing bonus. Quick questions before I sign:

- Relocation reimbursement: I would prefer an advance to cover upfront moving costs if possible. If not, can we have a short partial advance (50%) and the remainder upon receipts?
- Start date: I can target Oct 19 for a remote-first start. My landlord lease runs until Oct 31, so anything earlier would be hard.
- Equity: can you confirm the strike price timing and whether the first tranche vests at my first anniversary or at a calendar cadence?

If we can confirm the partial advance option and Oct 19 start, I'm comfortable moving forward and will sign as soon as I get the DocuSign link.
